tei:div.tei:p: ༈ rdzogs pa chen po mnyam nyid rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs/

rgya gar skad du/ mahā sandhi sa ma ko nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdzogs pa chen po mnyam nyid rang grol zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kun mnyam nyid ye nas byang chub pas/ /brjod med bsam 'das mkha' dbyings brdal ba'i klong*/ /mi gnas mi dmigs rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang*/ /rnam dag byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rtse mo kun gyi theg pa ni/ /rgyu 'bras las 'das spang blang re dogs bral/ /gang yin kun yin ngos bzung med pas na/ /rgya chad phyogs lhung bral pa'i don 'di nyon/ /snang srid 'khor 'das ye grol 'og min gnas/ /sna tshogs ma 'gag ye shes gzhal yas su/ /mnyam rdzogs ston pa chos nyid mi 'gyur bas/ /snod bcud rgyud drug sku gsum 'khor rnams la/ /dus gsum dus med gzhi rdzogs dag pa'i dus/ /blang dor rtsol sgrub med pa'i chos bstan pa/ /phyi nang bya ba'i chos ni dpag med kyang*/ /bstan pa'i theg pa rnam pa dgur gsungs shing*/ /de dag rang bzhin dbang po'i rim pa ste/ /nges pa'i don la kun des nam mkha' 'dra/ /theg pa med cing nges par 'byung ba med/ /'ong med 'gro med spang gnyen bral thob med/ /thams cad chos nyid 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang*/ /ji ltar snang ba de ltar rang bzhin med/ /rgyu 'bras ming 'dogs phyi nang byang chub sems/ /ye nas 'od gsal lhun grub ngang yin pas/ /grub bsal mi dmigs rang byung ye shes la/ /phyi nang 'bad pas ci zhig btsal du med/ /ma bcos rnal du 'jog pa chos nyid dang*/ /dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med kyi gang bder thongs/ /'di zhes dmigs su yod pa'i gzung 'dzin dang*/ /dgag sgrub blang dor med kyis rang sar zhog /nyon mongs ma spangs rang byung ye shes lnga/ /gang shar nyid nas rang grol spang blang med/ /spang bsgyur mi dgos sems sangs rdzogs pa che/ /ye bab rang byung da ltar lhun gyis grub/ /tha mal sna tshogs lhun rdzogs dkyil 'khor che/

/ma byas rang byung gzhal yas khang chen nas/ /gzugs tshor 'du shes 'du byed rnam par shes/ /rigs lnga sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i khams/ /yul lnga'i rang bzhin snang srid rnam dag pas/ /spang blangs mi dgos bcos bsgyur gnyen pos stong*/ /thams cad ro mnyam rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang*/ /gzhi rdzogs gdod nas dag par shes par gyis/ /ye stong rtsa ba bral ba'i sems nyid ni/ /ma byas lhun gyis grub pa'i sangs rgyas te/ /ji bzhin bzhag pa'i de bzhin mnyam par gnas/ /thog mtha'i dus min snga phyi'i 'pho 'gyur med/ /rtsis med rig med gol sgrib kun las 'das/ /bgrod pa'i sa med phyin pa'i lam yang med/ /ngo bo med la sbyang bgrod gang 'dod pa/ /de dag nam mkha' bcos bsgyur byed pa zad/ /rang byung ye shes bcos bslad kun dang bral/ / zla ba'i rgya mtsho rnyog pa ye nas med/ /dag dang ma dag dbyings gcig rol pa che/ /'di ni yang zab snying po'i dgongs klong yin/ /thams cad kun byed chos nyid yangs pa ni/ /kun gyi snying po rang bzhin lhun 'byams zhing*/ /ngo bo gsal la thugs rje ma 'gag pa/ /ji bzhin nyid nas ye bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /dbyings gcig chos nyid nam mkha'i rang bzhin las/ /gzhan pa'i chos ni rdul tsam mi dmigs pas/ /chos can snang stong chos nyid cho 'phrul du/ /rang bzhin lhun grub rol par shar ba yin/ /snod bcud snang srid dus gsum sangs rgyas kyang*/ /de bzhin nyid las gzhan du mi dmigs la/ /ye nas ma byas rang bzhin rnam dag pas/ /glo bur mi sbyor ngo bo'i shes pa grol/ /bya rtsol mi dgos rgyu rkyen kun las 'das/ /rang bzhin gzhan yin kun yin ngos bzung med/ /gang ltar brtags pa de yin glo bur tsam/ / dpyad na mi gnas brtag phyir ngo bos stong*/ /yin min blo yin blo bral chos sku yin/ /bral ba gzhan min gang shar 'dzin med yin/ /gcig gi rang bzhin nam mkha' lta bu la/

/tha dad blo yi grub mtha' mang po snang*/ /kun 'dus rdzogs chen byang chub sems de ni/ /nam mkha' bzhin du khyab cing go 'byed pas/ /chos rnams kun gyi 'byung gnas chen po yin/ /sna tshogs chos kun mnyam rdzogs rol pa las/ /bde sdug mtho dman sgyu ma chu zla'i gzugs/ /med bzhin snang bas don la gos pa med/ /lhun rdzogs gnyis su med pa'i ngang nyid do/ /ji ltar snang yang de ltar ma grub pas/ /rgyu 'bras gnyis med sgro skur bral ba la/ /dge sdig lung la ltos pa'i theg pa can/ / yang dag don dang nam yang 'phrad mi 'gyur/ /dam pa'i don la ma skyes gdod nas dag /snang dus mi dmigs gzung 'dzin spros pa bral/ /de las gzhan zhig nam yang mi dmigs pas/ /rgyu 'bras 'das pas rnal ma mthong ba med/ /da dung gal te rgyu 'bras las rkyen 'dod/ /des te snang 'di'i rang bzhin brtag par gyis/ /phyi rol yul lnga'i dang po'i rgyu 'bras gang*/ /sems kyi rang bzhin gang zhig gang gis skyes/ /de ltar dpyad na mkha' bzhin dngos med de/ /rgyu 'bras 'das phyir gdod ma'i chos nyid dang*/ /ma byas ma byung lhun gyis grub par nges/ /de las rtsol sgrub zhen pas ci byar yod/ / chos kun ye nas stong zhing bdag med kyang*/ /ma rig 'dzin pas srid pa 'dir 'khyams te/ /de las bde sdug sna tshogs snang na yang*/ /rmi lam nang bzhin don la grub pa med/ /ma byas rang bzhin dag pa'i sangs rgyas te/ /ye stong gzhi rtsa bral bar shes par bya/ /gang rnams blo yis brtags pa ngo bos stong*/ /gcig dang tha dad gnyis med chos rnams la/ /mi mkhas bden par zhen pas rang nyid 'ching*/ /sna tshogs grub mtha'i gzeb kyis grol ba med/ / drang nges rgyu 'bras lung gi rjes 'brangs te/ /blos brtags chos kyi 'khor ba rgyun mi 'chad/ /'di ltar rgyu yi theg pa gsum dag ni/ /spang 'gegs gnyen pos sems nyid sbyong ba ste/

/rang byung ye shes so ma bcos bslad med/ / grangs med gsum sogs grol ba rnyed mi 'gyur/ /'bras bu 'dod pa'i theg pa gnyis dag las/ /gsang sngags phyi pa gsum las kri ya ni/ /thams cad dbyings gcig dag pa'i chos nyid la/ /rje khol tshul gyis gnyis 'dzin blang dor byed/ /re dogs gzeb las nam yang thar ba med/ /gcig dngaganyis su bzung bas bslad pa yin/ /u pas rang bzhin dag pa'i chos nyid la/ / spun dang grogs bzhin gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pas bslad/ /ngo bo gcig la blang dor gnyis phye bas/ /don gyi snying po nam yang mthong mi nus/ /yo gas mngon byang lnga dang cho 'phrul bzhi/ /de bzhin nyid la bcos bslad med par zad/ /ye nas ma skyes phyi nas grub pa med/ /sems nyid don gyi snying po mthong ba med/ /kun kyang bcu drug bdun dang gsum gyi tsher/ /gnyug ma'i rang bzhin grol ba'i sa la sgrib/ /nang pa gsum las ma hās dag pa'i sems/ /bsnyen sgrub bzhi dang 'phro 'dus bcos bslad byed/ /ye nas yin na bcos bsgyur mi dgos la/ /min na phan med nam mkha'i mdud pa bzhin/ /blang dor med pa'i ngo bo mthong ba med/ /a nus dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med dang*/ /snying po gcig la rgyu 'bras bcos bsgyur med/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin gnyis med dag pa la/ /bde dang stong pas nam yang ci byar yod/ /a ti bskyed rdzogs gnyis med byang chub sems/ /mtha' bral ngang du snying po'i sems nyid 'ching*/ /nam mkha'i zhags pas sems nyid 'ching bar zad/ /stong pa'i phyogs tsam gding du su 'cha' ba/ /kun gyis snang ba'i de nyid shes min gyi/ /chos kun mnyam rdzogs gcig gi don mi shes/ /chad pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /sems shes su zhig rab tu bsten par bgyi/ /de ltar de dag rtsol sgrub spang len dang*/ /dmigs med ngang du rang sems dri med 'ching*/ /snying po'i de nyid rtogs pa'i mthu med cing*/

/skal ngan chos ngan grub pa'i mtha' ngan pas/ /spang thob med pa'i de nyid mthong ba med/ /lam la bgrod cing sa la sbyong bar byed/ /brtson pa'i nad kyis gdung ba'i dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pas mi dag srid par 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /rang byung ye shes dgongs par phyin pa med/ /byang chub nyid kyang nam mkha'i rang bzhin la/ /byang chub sems kyang nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /byang chub lam la su zhig bgrod du yod/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su bgrod pa'i sems zhog la/ /spang blang bya btsal med pa'i don mthong mdzod/ /chos kun ma skyes sgrib pa med pa la/ /blo yi 'dzin pas gol sgrib gnyis su 'byung*/ /ngo bo med la bgrod pas gol ba ste/ /blta ru med la bltas pas sgrib pa 'byung*/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa rang rang gzhung bzhin du/ /ci tsam 'bad cing rtsol ba de srid par/ /gol zhing bsgribs pas rnal ma mthong ba med/ /ji ltar bzang pos bzang po btsal ba'i tshe/ /ji tsam btsal ba de tsam gol zhing sgrib/ /mthong bar 'dod na bzang po ma btsal bar/ /rang nyid bzang po yin par thag chod ltos/ /de bzhin dag pa'i sems kyis sems btsal yang*/ / btsal bya'i don gyis tshol mkhan byas pas 'khrul/ /'di ni ye nas dag pa'i sems nyid la/ /bcos bsgyur gnyen pos ma btsal rang gar zhog /rang byung gcig la theg pa dgur bltas pas/ /gol sgrib mi 'char chu yi gnyer ma 'dra/ /bltas pas mi mthong btsal bas rnyed pa med/ /ye nas grub bsal med par rang bzhin zhog /ye shes mi shes zab zhi phra ba med/ /gnyis med 'brel med sgro skur mtha' las 'das/ /ji bzhin rang bzhin ye bzhin lhun grub pas/ /gang yin de nyid kun yin chen por zhog /lhun gyis grub la rtsol zhing 'bad mi dgos/ /med pa bltas pas mthong ba 'ga' yod dam/ / de bas chos kun ma skyes chos nyid dang*/ /rgyu 'bras 'das pa'i de nyid gsal ba ltos/ /'dir ni bla ma'i man ngag snying po'i don/

/chos nyid don gyi nam mkha' mtha' dbus med/ /rgyu 'bras bskyed rdzogs lam la mi ltos par/ /sems nyid rgyal po lhun grub yon tan rdzogs/ /chags med re ba 'jog pa'i ting 'dzin gyi/ /snying po'i sems nyid mi mthong bsam yul 'das/ /sna tshogs spros pa 'phel ba'i rtog dpyod kyis/ /gdod ma'i gnas lugs mi mthong blo las 'das/ /sna tshogs thabs tshul rgya mtsho'i rin chen gyis/ /ji bzhin nyid ni ye bzhin mthong ba med/ /cog gzhag re dogs bral na de ring nyid/ /gang na 'dug par mthong ste lta ba med/ /'di las gzhan du bcos pas bzang por rlom/ /the tshom yid gnyis za bas rang nyid sgrib/ sna tshogs chos kyi rnam grangs don gcig par/ /snying po'i sems nyid ma bcos rnal ma ste/ /sku gsum zhing yin ston pa 'khor gnas su/ /bstan pa phun tshogs lnga yi rang bzhin te/ /de ltar shes par bzo med lhug par gnas/ / snga phyi dus gsum 'khor 'das rol pa'i sems/ /ma lus gcig tu gnas pa'i ngo bo ste/ /snying po lhun 'byams byang chub de bzhin nyid/ /ye nas sangs rgyas da lta'i chos nyid do/ /ma byas ye nas dag pa'i dgongs shar ba/ /sna tshogs brda yis mtshon te bstan du med/ /tshig dang ye ges de nyid go bar zad/ /theg pa'i rnams grangs rtse mor phyin pa'i sems/ /byang chub sems 'dus de nyid rtogs phyir te/ /thams cad dbyings gcig 'bral bar bshad pa yin/ /'di ni ma lus nges gsang snying po ste/ /der ni sems kyi de nyid mthong ba yin/ /skal ngan rnams kyis nam yang mi rtogs te/ /dmus long mdun du gzugs brnyan bstan pa bzhin/ /brda dang rten 'brel thabs kyis ga la go /skal bzang rnams la nyi zer padmo bzhin/ /bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs pa khong nas 'char*/ /rang gi ngo bo dus gsum mnyam nyid la/ /chos dang chos nyid ma rtog sor mar zhog /ye nas byang chub rang bzhin rnam dag pas/

/glo bur zhen pas ma 'chings ci dgar rol/ /chos dang chos can chos nyid mnyam pa'i ngang*/ /gang shar rig pa rang byung rol pa'i tshe/ /rang grol ye bab bcos bslad bral bar shog /sems nyid ma bcos chos sku'i rol pa las/ / yengs med bsam gtan 'dzin pa'i brtod phur gyis/ /gcig tu ma bsdu rtogs dang ma rtogs mnyam/ /legs nyes shor god rdul tsam mi dmigs pas/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i sgrog tu ma 'chings shig /ye nas yin la yengs dang ma yengs med/ /gcig tu sems 'dzin re dogs 'khrul pa'i yid/ / dmigs med rang la zhen par 'ching bar byed/ /sems dang sems nyid gnyis su mi dmigs la/ /stong dang mi stong mnyam pa'i ngang nyid du/ /shar gnas gang yin ye nas de ltar yin/ /de la dgag sgrub chags sdang ma byed par/ /ji ltar snang ba de ltar yin du chug /mi rtog mkha' ltar dag pa'i chos sku la/ /snang sems sna tshogs rol pa'i gzigs mor che/ /ma skyes spros bral skye ba'i cho 'phrul can/ /rtog dpyod dran bsam tshol khros ma bslad par*/ / gang yin ngang der gang shar rol du chug /thams cad kun yin chos nyid brdal ba la/ /spang blang ma byed de bzhin nyid du zhog /ji bzhin mi g.yo de bzhin mnyam par gnas/ /ye bzhin mtho dman med na gdod ma'i gnas/ /mi rtog mtha' dbus med kyi de bzhin zhog /rtsol bral chos sku gzugs med bstan du med/ chags bral zhi ba dngos med de bzhin nyid/ / bya bral nam mkha'i sems nyid bsgom du med/ /rtogs dang ma rtogs mnyam gyis ci bder zhog /lam med zhugs pa rnams kyi nad che ba/ /rtsol ba'i dug gis sems la gdung bar byed/ /ji ltar 'bad kyang 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras te/ /thar pa'i lam du nam yang phyin mi nus/ /rags pa'i sems la dkar nag goms byed pa/ /'dod khams nyid de mtho ris ngan song 'dzin/ / gsal ba'i sems gang dge bas rlan byed pa/ /gzugs khams nyid de bsam gtan rigs bzhir 'phen/

/mi rtogs sems gang shin tu mi g.yo bas/ /gzugs med nyid de mtha' sogs rnam bzhir 'khor/ /rnal ma'i sems la bcos bslad sus byed pa'i/ /gang ltar bcos pa de yis mi rtog skye/ /srid pa'i gnas las thar ba'i skabs med do/ /dus gsum gcig ste gdod nas byang chub che/ /mkha' bzhin bsam bral rang bzhin mnyam pa'i ngang*/ /ming tsam mi dmigs mtshungs bral mtshan ma med/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung rol pa chen po ni/ /gzhir rdzogs gleng bral brjod med lhun gyis grub/ /ma chags mi g.yo rang bzhin dag pa'i zhing*/ /mi nub rgyal mtshan nam mkha' chen po ni/ /sems nyid 'od gsal kun gyi snying po ste/ /sgrim dang lhod med tshogs kyi rgyan rnams kyang*/ /gnyis med lhun bzhag ji bzhin spros dang bral/ /rtsol bral snang zhing stong pa'i yul sems la/ /'di zhes mi mtshon rang bzhin lhug par zhog /ji bzhin stong ste ma bcos chos sku'i ngang*/ /mi rtog mnyam pa'i rgyal por lhun gyis grub/ /rgyal po dri med ji bzhin spang blang med/ /gnyug ma'i sangs rgyas rgyu 'bras 'das pa'i ngang*/ /ma skyes lhun rdzogs da lta'i sems nyid de/ /gang shar bcos bslad med pa lta ba'i don/ / rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang nyid do/ /chos nyid mi g.yo gcig las ma 'das kyang*/ /chos can mi 'gags sna tshogs so sor gsal/ /rab zhi ma skyes mkha' ltar dag pa ste/ /skye med ji bzhin ye shes sgrib pa med/ /kun khyab phyogs bral mchog gsang rdzogs pa che/ /gzhi rtsa dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /bya byed rtsol sgrub chos kyis

sgru ba mi dgos/ /ji bzhin ngang la de bzhin shes par gyis/ /gsang ba rgya mtsho shin tu sgrog pa'i gsung*/ /lhun rdzogs rig pa gang shar rol pa la/ /blang dor mi dmigs ye grol yangs pa che/ /rang grol shes pa rang bab gdod ma'i ngang*/ /rtogs pa'i ri rgyal rab tu mi g.yo bas/ /lhun 'byams thig le chen po'i dbyings su rol/ /rdzogs pa chen po mnyam nyid rang grol las/ /rab gzhi rtogs pas grol ba'i le'u ste dang pa'o// // de ltar lta ba bya rtsol chen po'i ngang*/ /rang bab shes pa ji bzhin klod pa'i tshe/ /gang shar rang grol ngang dwangs rgya mtsho 'dra/ /ma bsgoms yengs med bsam rdzogs gzung 'dzin bral/ /rang byung rig pa bcos bslad med pa ni/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i sgom pa yin/ /rtogs dang ma rtogs mnyam pa'i chos nyid la/ /bsam gtan sems 'dzin 'ching bas ma bslad par/ /'phro gnas gnyis med gdod ma'i ngang la zhog /mi spro mi bsdu mi bsgom tha mal ngang*/ /gang bab rig pa mnyam rdzogs 'dus ma byas/ / bsgom dang mi bsgom med par thag chod pas/ /ji bzhin ngang la ye bzhin lhug par zhog /bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin bde gsal mi rtogs sogs/ /ji sṛd blos byas mi rtog ye shes kyang*/ /bag chags nyid de srid pa'i rgyu 'bras tsam/ /mtshan bcas mtshan 'dzin rab zhi mkha' 'dra bas/ /gong ma'i skye gnas brgyud cing 'khor ba grub/ /gang la las dang bag chags gnyis med cing*/ /ting 'dzin mi bsgom rtog dpyod blo las 'das/ /de las srid med srid pa'i sdug bsngal med/ /skye med rdul bral mtshan med smon pa bral/ /ma btsal rang bzhag sgom pa'i rgyal po ni/ /ji bzhin ngang las cung zad g.yos pa med/ /gzhi nyid lta bas rtogs pa'i don bzhin du/ /gang ltar bshad kyang spang blang med pa'i sems/ /rang bzhag ltos bral ye bab rig pa ni/ /'dzin med chos sku rgyal po'i gtan srid zin/ /dbyings gcig gdod ma'i sa la da lta phyin/

/phyi nas 'bras bu sku gsum sgrub tu med/ /sangs rgyas byang chub ces pa'i rang bzhin te/ /mngon du gyur par re dogs gnyis dang bral/ / rang byung lhun grub kun tu bzang po'i sa/ /ma bcos rnal bzhag chen por lhun gyis grub/ /rnying po'i sems nyid res 'jog med pa'i lam/ /ma bsgoms chu bo'i rgyun bzhin gnas pa la/ /gol sgrib gnyis med bde klong gcig tu 'khyil/ /grub dang ma grub med pas blo bde rnyed/ /yin dang ma yin med par phyam gcig pas/ /thams cad gzhi rdzogs kun tu bzang po yin/ kha dog ngos bzung med pa'i rig pa 'di/ /grub dang ma grub med par thag chod pas/ /ji bzhin ma bcos tha mal lhug par zhog /sna tshogs 'phro 'du rang byung ye shes mdangs/ /chu dang rlabs bzhin bzang ngan mi dmigs pas/ /kun kyang rang byung bya rtsol med pa yin/ /rang grol gdod nas dag pa'i lta ba la/ /ma spangs sor bzhag kun rdzogs gcig gi ngang*/ /sgrim klod gnyis med rang byung ye shes che/ /rtsol bral ngang du dran bsam las 'das pa/ /'od gsal sems nyid dag pa'i sgom pa yin/ /snang srid chos rnams ma skyes stong pa'i ngang*/ /sgom gsum lhug pa de bzhin nyid du zhog /kun rdzob snying po rnam gzhag rig pa'i ngang*/ /phyi nang gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa yin/ /gang snang don la der 'dzin ma byed par/ /rang shar rig pa'i rang grol don la bskyang/ /dgongs pa mi g.yo thun mtshams gcig gi ngang*/ /dus gsum dus med mnyam par lhun gyis grub/ /yul sems ji ltar snang yang chos nyid ngang*/ /gzhi gzhag sgom pa'i mchog yin dran bsam 'das/ / mkha' mnyam mnyam bzhag gcig tu lhun rdzogs pas/ /thams cad ma skyes bde chen rol par shar/ /rang byung bsgom du med pa'i snying po ni/ /tha mal shes pa bzo med zang kha ma/ /'phro na rang grol gnas na mnyam pa nyid/ / nyon mongs de nyid stong gsal ye shes lnga/ /spang gnyen sbyong bsgyur mi dgos gdod ma'i ngang*/

/mkha' mnyam skye med chos sku'i rol pa 'o/ /snying po mtshan ma med pa'i ye shes la/ /rang byung bsgom du med kyi gang bder thongs/ /ma bsam re dogs bral ba'i shes pa la/ /'ching grol gdod nas mi dmigs gzhi rtsa med/ /gang gis 'ching ba de nyid grol ba ste/ /nyon mongs gnyen po gnyis med de bzhin nyid/ /ji bzhin yul la skyon yon gnyis med pa/ /kun byed rig pa rang yan chen por zhog /ma bcos rnal bzhag phyogs ris med pa'i ngang*/ /stong pa mtshan ma med ces mi dmigs pas/ /dbyings gcig de bzhin nyid du sems la zhog /'di ltar gcig tu nges pa'i don la nyon/ / 'jig rten bya ba'i las dang chos rnams kun/ /byas pas mi zin rang bzhin bzhag na zin/ /de bas rtsol sgrub chos kyis dgos pa med/ /ji ltar dpyad pa de ltar 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /grub dang ma grub re dogs gzeb y-in pas/ /rang bab sor bzhag ji bzhin nyid du zhog /'das pa'i chos rnams 'gag pas bsgom du med/ /ma 'ongs ma skyes sgom pa'i yul na med/ /da lta'i sems la bsgom dang sgom byed med/ /dus gsum mnyam nyid sgom yul kun las 'das/ /de bas sgom pa'i sems 'dzin ma byed par/ /rang bab shes pa gang bab ngang der zhog /bsam gyis mi khyab bde chen nges pa'i lung*/ /gang la de gnas mnyam rdzogs chen po nyid/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med snying po'i don/ /skye med phyogs bral 'phel 'grib kun las 'das/ /'du shes mi 'gog yul rnams de bzhin nyid/ /'dzin byed mi dmigs spang gnyen rang sar grol/ /ma bsgoms lhug pa mnyam rdzogs chen po la/ /yangs dog mtho dman rgya chad phyogs lhung med/ /ma spangs re dogs chad pa'i ngang nyid du/ / mi bsam 'du 'phro zhig pa'i byang chub sems/ /kun gsal rang bzhin dag pa'i ngang du zhog /sna tshogs snang grags chos rnams sems kyi ngang*/ / sems nyid mi g.yo rang bzhin gdod ma'i ngang*/

/chos dang chos nyid med par la bzlas pas/ /'khor 'das mi dmigs mnyam rdzogs ngang nyid du/ / dran pas tshol khro med par mnyam par zhog /gcig tu ma bsdus gnyis su ma 'dzin par/ /lhun grub re dogs bral ba'i nam mkha' la/ /yengs med spros dang bral ba'i shes pa nyid/ /rgya chad phyogs lhung bral ba'i tshul gyis zhog / rgya bskyed dpang bstod mtha' dbus brdal bar bskyed/ /ma bzung ma btang rang gsal gcig tu ltos/ /phyam me khyab brdal dbyings gcig gdod ma'i ngang*/ /bsam rdzogs ye shes 'od gsal khong nas 'char/ /gnyis med don la 'jug pa kun 'dod kyang*/ /blos bzung chos las 'gro kun ma 'das pas/ /theg pa'i mtho dman don gcig snying po med/ /nges don brjod bral ma skyes rnam par dag /sems nyid mi g.yo sangs rgyas rang bzhin la/ / bcos bsgyur 'bad pa'i phyi nas dag par 'dod/ /'khor ba spangs nas mya ngan 'das 'tshol la/ /rmongs pa de yis snying po'i don mi mthong*/ /sgom pa'i rjes la sgom med rdzogs pa'i chos/ /mkha' ltar dri med skye ba gang 'dod pa/ /de la lta ba'i de nyid mthong ba med/ /phyi nas dag pa'i sgom med ci 'dra skye/ /'di ni rtogs mthong goms pas yon tan 'char/ /'on kyang rtogs pa bzang ngan 'pho 'gyur med/ /de ltar shes na skyes bu mkhas pa yin/ /rmong pas mi go rgyu 'bras tshad mar 'dzin/ /rgyu rkyen dngos po'i rten 'brel chos dpags nas/ /sems nyid dngos med don la rtsol sgrub byed/ /de ni sa bon myu gu bskyed mthong nas/ /nam mkha' sbyangs pas rgyu 'bras 'dod par zad/ /ha cang ma 'brel phan tshun 'gal ba can/ /dngos med sems la bcos pas ci byar yod/ /nam mkhar skyed tshal myu gu skye ba bzhin*/ /dngos med de bzhin nyid la bcos ma byed/ /'di ltar chos tshul bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /sa sogs dngos por snang ba'i chos rnams la/ /rgyus bskyed rkyen gyis bsgyur bas sna tshogs byed/

/mkha' dang de bzhin nyid chos dag pa la/ / 'bad cing rtsol bas mi 'grub 'pho 'gyur med/ /de bzhin sems la bag chags 'khrul pa gang*/ /ji ltar 'bad rtsol 'khor ba rgyun mi 'chad/ /sems nyid mi g.yo snga phyi 'pho 'gyur med/ /de bas sems nyid dag pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /bcos bsgyur ma byed de bzhin nyid du zhog /nam mkha' bcos pa'i ngal ba ma byed kye/ /grub dang ma grub rang bzhin med pas na/ /rtogs dang ma rtogs gnyis su mi 'dzin par/ /rang byung chos la gang byung de bzhin zhog /ma bcos ji bzhin bzhag na gdod ma'i ngang*/ /snying po'i 'od gsal rgyun chad med pas na/ /gang bab ngang la rang bab chen por zhog /ngang dwangs 'od gsal nyi zla lta bu'i sems/ /dga' bde phan yon bcas pa skye bar 'gyur/ /'di la mchog dang dman pa'i chos med pas/ /dmigs bral ma rtsol bde bas lus sems khyab/ /kun grol gdod nas ji bzhin dmigs su med/ /ma byas rang bzhin dag pa'i rgyal po ni/ /phyogs bral ye shes snang ba 'char bar byed/ /kun 'dus rang bzhag mi 'gyur snying po'i don/ /ji bzhin mi 'chos sgom pa'i ngang la zhog /ji ltar byas kyang sgom par shar ba na/ /ma bsgoms gang shar bzhag kyang yengs ba med/ /mthar phyin lhun grub chen po'i sgom pa yin/ /lta sgom bogs 'byin spyod pa'i rim pa yang*/ /sgyu ma sprul pa gnyis med chu zla'i ngang*/ /spyod lam dus drug kun tu bzang por spyod/ /gang la bzang ngan yod na spyod pa min/ /blang dor re dogs bral bar shes par bya/ /'dod pa'i yul rnams gang dang gang la yang*/ /chags zhen dgag sgrub yod na spyod pa min/ /ji ltar sgyu mas sgyu ma'i yul rnams la/ / gang ltar spyod kyang zhen 'dzin med par ltar/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa ma chags rol par spyod/ /chos so cog la ngos bzung 'ga' med de/ /med bzhin snang la don du ma 'dzin par/ /gnyis med rang grol rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang*/

/ ji bzhin nyid du de bzhin spyad par bya/ /'di zhes gnyis su spyod pa'i sems yod par/ /gnyug ma'i rang bzhin mi mthong 'khrul pa'i blo/ /mtha' bral spyod kyang de yi mthar lhung zhing*/ /sgyu mar 'dod pa gang gi gzeb tu 'ching*/ / rang sems ye grol chos nyid chen po la/ /spyod dang mi spyod blang dor gnyis med kyi/ rtsol ba'i nad kyis gdung bar ma byed par/ /ji bzhin gnyis med de bzhin nyid du zhog /thams cad dbyings gcig mnyam pa'i ngo bo ste/ / gdod ma'i ye shes sems nyid rdzogs pa che/ /rang byung don gyi snying po gang bder spyod/ /lhun rdzogs yin gyi rtsol sgrub ma byed cig /gnas lugs yin gyi bcos bsgyur ma byed cig /ye nas yin gyi da gzod ma sgrubs shig / grub bsal med kyi sbyang bsgyur ma byed cig /phyogs ris med kyi 'di zhes ma 'dzin cig /'khor 'das med kyi re dogs ma byed cig /bzang ngan med kyi blang dor ma byed cig /ji ltar sgom dang spyod par byas na yang*/ /rang gi sems las gzhan du g.yos pa med/ /de la spang blang mchod bshags ci byar yod/ /'ching ba'i bsam gtan sems kyi nad du che/ /dag pa'i sems la 'dzin pas ma bslad par/ /gang shar rgyal po ji bzhin rol du chug /bzang ngan blang dor med na spyod pa yin/ /gang la 'di zhes rdul tsam zhen 'dzin yod/ /de la de nyid gol sgrib chen por bshad/ /tshad med nam mkha'i dbyings la ma 'dzin par/ /dag pa'i sems nyid nam mkhas mtshon te byon/ /snang yul thabs la blo ni shes rab dang*/ /gzung 'dzin mi dmigs rgya yan chen por spyod/ /bsod nams ye shes bskyed rdzogs rnams par dag /rol pa 'gag med sgyu mar lhun gyis grub/ /snang sems ngo bo ma skyes chos sku la/ /rang bzhin mi 'gags gsal stong longs spyod rdzogs/ /sna tshogs shar grol sprul skur phyam gcig par/ /thams cad sku gsum ye shes chen por spyad/

/snang zhing mi rtog rol par shar ba'i tshe/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa'i yon tan ma lus rdzogs/ /de yang sems nyid bsam gtan rin chen mdzod/ /srid dang zhi ba mnyam nyid rdzogs pa che/ /gdod nas dag pa'i ngo bo mthong ba'i tshe/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa zhes btags pa ste/ /gnyis 'dzin dri med dri ma med pa'i sa/ /rtogs pa'i 'od byed 'od 'phro can dang ni/ /kun gyi yul min spyad dka' mngon du gyur/ /srid las ring song chos nyid mi g.yo ba/ /kun gyi rab mchog legs pa'i blo gros can/ /ye shes nyi ma dri med chos kyi sprin/ /cha yi dbye bas de ltar bcu dang ni/ /gnyis med don mthong tshogs lam spyod pas sbyor/ /rtogs pa rab mthong don goms sgom pa'i lam/ /gtan srid zin pas mi slob 'bras bur brjod/ /sgo gsum ye shes chen por gzhir dag pas/ /bum gsang shes rab tshig dbang rnam pa bzhi/ / yul sems snang stong bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel sogs/ /ji snyed dbye ba de snyed yon tan ldan/ /ma btsal lhun gyis grub pas rdzogs pa che/ /byas chos bsam las 'das na mthong ba yin/ /bltas pas mi mthong bsgoms pas grub pa med/ /dpyad pas mi rnyed bya rtsol kun las 'das/ /rang sems snying po 'gyur med sangs rgyas te/ /yid ni 'khor 'das kun la ye nas yod/ /khyab ni dus gsum snga phyi med par khyab/ /yin ni chos dbyings rgyu 'bras 'das pa yin/ /blta rgyu mtshan ma'i dngos med nam mkha' 'dra/ /rang byung ye shes gzhi gnas mi g.yo ba/ /mtsho bzhin ngang gis 'od gsal dwangs pa ste/ /yul la mi rtog de bzhin nyid du gsal/ /byad bzhin rang gnas rkyen la ltos pa med/ /yul la ltos na ye nas rang byung min/ /gzhan 'byung yin pas sna tshogs g.yo bar 'gyur/ /des na dus kun rang byung 'pho 'gyur med/ /'char gzhi ma 'gag sku gsum 'du 'bral med/ /rang bzhin stong la ngo bo gsal pa'i ngang*/ /thugs rje ma 'gag rig pa'i snying por gnas/

/nang gsal mi g.yo ji bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /yul la rtog pa'i ye shes gang shar ba/ /rtsal lam mdangs kyi ye shes zhes bya ste/ /rlabs sam me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /yul yod rkyen gyis de blo 'char ba ste/ /med na mi 'byung 'brel pa grub pa na/ /rang la shar bas rang byung zhes btags kyang*/ / rgyun du min pas gzhan 'byung rkyen gyi yul/ /'phro 'du'i rol pa 'gag pa med pa yin/ /de yang gzhi gnas rang byung dbyibs yin la/ /yul la shar ba'i shes pa ye shes te/ /ji bzhin bzhag pa gnyis su med pa yin/ /don 'di mi shes rmongs pa'i bsam gtan pa/ /kha cig dbyings nyid ngang bzhag 'ba' zhig btsal/ /'du shes tshor ba 'gog pa'i sems 'dzin gyis/ / gzugs dang gzugs med bag chags 'khor ba sgrub/ /kha cig yul gyi ye shes phyir bltas la/ /rang grol zer nas 'phro 'du'i rtog pa 'dren/ /kun rtog spros pas 'dod pa'i srid pa 'ching/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med rtog pa med/ /la la bskyed rdzogs rgyu 'bras sna tshogs kyis/ /snying po'i sems nyid rnal ma'i don la sgrib/ 'khor ba'i grong las thar pa'i skabs med do/ /'dir ni gang shar spang blang med pa'i tshe/ /ngang dwangs dbyings der rig pa la bzlas nas/ /gnyis med gcig tu bde klong 'khyil pa'i tshe/ / 'phro gnas gnyis med mnyam rdzogs chen por grol/ /ngang yin ye yin rdzogs pa chen po yin/ /spang blang mi dgos sems sangs chen po yin/ /ye nas rtog pa med pa'i sems nyid la/ /da lta gang shar gze re ma byas na/ / snang sems mi rtog chos sku'i zhing du grol/ /phyi nas mnyam rdzogs de bzhin sgrub tu med/ /rang byung gcig la yul drug shar ba'i tshe/ /brtags dpyad mi dgos ji bzhin lhug par zhog

/me long gzugs brnyanaganyis med dwangs pa bzhin/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med lhun gyis grub/ /yul la shar yang phyi ru ma 'phros pas/ /sems nyid dwangs pa'i gzugs brnyan rol pa tsam/ / thams cad dbyings gcig ye nas shes pa'i phyir/ /rang byung ye shes bcos bslad med pa'i don/ /rgyu 'bras 'das pa'i ngo bo bstan pa yin/ /ji ltar blo yis bkod pa'i chos rnams ni/ /bag chags yin phyir rgyu 'bras 'khor ba 'khyams/ /bde sdug bzang ngan sna tshogs so sor snang*/ /sa bon tha dad 'bras bu 'byung ba bzhin/ /ji bzhin ma bcos sems nyid 'od gsal ni/ / rgyu 'bras gnyis med ye nas bya rtsol med/ /mkha' bzhin ma skyes mi 'gags mi gnas pas/ /dus gsum 'pho 'gyur brjod med bsam las 'das/ /ma btsal lhun gyis grub pas skyon yon med/ /rol pa 'gag pa med pas chos kyi dbyings/ /rang bzhin gcig la bcos bslad ma byed cig /bgrod pas mi phyin sbyangs pas dag pa med/ /btsal bas mi rnyed ji bzhin lhug par zhog /sku dang ye shes yon tan lhun gyis grub/ /ma bcos de bzhin nyid du bzhag pas 'grub/ /bya rtsol ma byed sems nyid nam mkha' che/ /ye nas dag pas rgyu 'bras rtsol mi dgos/ /rang sems chos sku lhun grub don 'dod na/ /gang snang yul sems dmigs gtad zhen pa bshol/ / 'di zhes ched 'dzin med na mngon du 'gyur/ /kun yin gcig yin gza' gtad med pas na/ /phyogs bral rig pa mnyam med yin par zhog /chos la byar med byas pas zin pa med/ /zin med rang bzhag bcos bslad ma byed par/ /gang yin kun yin 'di yin nges med pas/ /mtha' bral klong yangs rdzogs pa chen por zhog /bzhag sa yod na rdzogs pa chen po min/ /ci yin 'di yin ngos bzung ma byed cig /rdzogs pa chen po mnyam nyid rang grol las/ /lam goms pas grol ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// // de ltar gzhi lam dbyings rig mthar phyin tshe/

/gzhi rdzogs 'bras bu gdod mar lhun gyis grub/ /rang don chos sku gzhan don gzungs sku gnyis/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med 'du 'bral med/ /'khor 'das gnyis med rig pa dbyings gcig tu/ /zhi bar bzhugs pa spros dang bral ba'i tshe/ /kun bzang dbye ba med pa'i sa zhes bya/ /'di ni mi gnas bsam rdzogs chos sku'i ngang*/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i chos nyid do/ /de nyid ngang las phra ba'i ye shes ni/ /nang gsal 'char gzhi ma 'gag thams cad mkhyen/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa ni/ /ting 'dzin mi g.yo mnyam rdzogs chen po'i sa/ /de nyid ngang las rnam pa phyir bzhengs nas/ / 'od gsal snang bas kun bzang yab yum gyi/ /'phro 'du'i rol pa 'khor lo tshogs chen sa/ /de nyid ngang las zhi ba rigs lnga'i zhing*/ /'od gsal lhun rdzogs rang snang dag pa yin/ /zhing dang ston pa chos 'khor dus rnams te/ / phun gsum tshogs pa lnga lngar snang ba las/ /chos dbyings me long mnyam nyid so sor rtog /bya grub ye shes lnga lnga'i rang bzhin ni/ /stug po bkod pa'i sa zhes brjod pa yin/ / de nyid ngang las khro bo'i zhing khams ni/ /dkyil 'khor lhun rdzogs rigs lngar snang ba nyid/ /sku dang ye shes nam mkha' mnyam sbyor ba/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa zhes brjod pa yin/ /de nyid ngang la sa bcu'i sems dpa' la/ /rnam dag mi bskyod rin 'byung 'od dpag med/ / don grub snang bas 'khor rgyud sbyang ba'i phyir/ /me long lta bus gdul bya'i don mdzad pa/ /ma chags padma can gyi sa zhes bya/ /de nyid ngang las ma dag gdul bya la/ /'gro 'dul thub pa drug dang skye ba dang*/ /bzo dang mkho rgu'i yo byad sna tshogs te/ /mdor na mthun pa'i snang gzugs ston pa dang*/ /so sor snang bas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /kun tu 'od kyi sa zhes bya ba yin/ / nyi ma'i 'od kyis gling bzhi snang byed cing*/ /padmo 'dzum pas dga' ba bskyed pa bzhin/

/sprul pa'i 'od zer snang bas khyab par byed/ /kun bzang dbye ba med dang ting nge 'dzin/ /gnyis med chos sku'i sa yin spros kun zhi/ /tshogs chen stug po bkod dang rdo rje 'dzin/ /rang snang longs sku'i sa yin 'od gsal dang*/ /padma can dang kun tu 'od zer 'gyed/ /rang bzhan 'gro 'dul sna tshogs sprul sku'i sa/ / mdzad pa'i phrin las dpag med lhun gyis grub/ /de ltar sku dang ye shes zhing rnams kyang*/ /nam mkha' bzhin du rtag khyab 'dus ma byas/ /'gro grol bar du rgyun mi 'chad par snang*/ /'di ni mthar phyin gdod ma'i ngang nyid de/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i 'bras bu yin/ /rgyu 'bras bskyed min ye nas lhun grub yin/ /ma byas rang bzhin dag pa'i sems nyid la/ /mi byed rtsol sgrub med pa'i don mthong nas/ /rang bab ye grol sor bzhag klong gyur pas/ /ye nas lhun grub mngon du gyur pa yin/ /rdzogs pa chen po mnyam nyid rang grol las/ /'bras bu lhun grub chen po'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// // de ltar chos tshul shin tu rmad byung 'di/ /gangs ri thod dkar rin chen snying po'i mgul/ /dri med 'od zer shar bas snang byas pas/ /dge bas 'gro kun yid kyi mun sel shog /dpal ldan ge sar gsal ba'i dbang po yis/ /bdag blo'i sbrang rtsi 'dzin 'di dga' bskyed pas/ /legs bshad glu dbyangs dar dir snyan par bsgrags/ /de yis skal ldan skye bo dga' bar mdzod/ /rdzogs pa chen po mnyam nyid rang grol zhes bya ba/ /dpal o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po padma'i dbang pos legs par rjes su bzung pa'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du bkod pa rdzogs so// //dge'o// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (22) rdzogs pa chen po mnyam nyid rang grol/ - PAGE 444 - - PAGE 465 -- PAGE 443 -
